sections.text: Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction

This document outlines the major 
maintenance procedure P1, which must be carried out when the 
discharge pressure value < 88 bar at max. flow or flow decreasing at normal pressure 88 bar.

The pump technical data:
 Type: Centrifugal pump multistage RPM 
: 2980 
 No of stage : (1+8) 
Power : 789 KW
 Suction pressure : 1.8 
bar 
Max .flow : 266 m3/ h
 Discharge pressure : 88 bar

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed 
Taha El Mansy , tested by eng. Abdel Qader Fath Alla at 26 Feb 2003 
on Module 1 pump no. A and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir 
Abdel Gilel, accepted by general director eng. Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry 
and approved by eng. Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector 
of Demietta PS.
Safety Precautions

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Wear 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Shut down the pump.

Disconnect the power 
 supply & rack out the circuit breaker

Close the shutoff 
 valves in the (suction & discharge & balancing & min .flow )
Put red tag on the pump

Let the pumps cool down 
 to about < 80oC measured at the branches, then seal off the 
 cooling water pipes and close all other supply lines.

Loosen all auxiliary 
 lines, such as circulation, cooling liquid, lub. oil.

The safety department must 
 check the isolation and surrounding the zone of work.

Plain 
Bearings

Check all bearing components and segmental pads for damages. Light pressure 
 marks on the pads resp. in the bore of the bearing shells may be removed by means of scraper 
with regard to

slack ( i.e. if it is possible to move the bearing shell ), the two faces of the 
bearing housing must be 
touched up evenly until the bearing shell can once more be clamped absolutely 
tight in its seat. If new bearing shells are fitted ,their seats should in principle be fitted in 
the manner described

sections.text:
Thrust 
Bearing

Check the rubbing 
pattern on the thrust bearing segments (387) and, if necessary, remove any light 
pressure marks or scores.

Check the rubbing pattern on the 
thrust bearing plate (384) on both sides. Remove deep scores 
by machining. Admissible wobble of the thrust bearing plate 0.005 
mm. Surface finish Ra = 0.4 mic. If the thrust bearing segments are replaced by 
new ones, or if any extensive touching-up work of the white metal rubbing 
faces in carried out, an BLUING Ink.

Check is to be 
carried out in assembled condition with the thrust bearing plate (384). When 
fitting a new thrust bearing plate, the wobble of the plate should be checked 
with a dial micrometer. The rotor should not abut the pump body.

sections.text: Attention:

If you do not intend to dismantle the body 
of the pump measure the approximate total radial play . 
 attach 
the indicator to a fixed support (e.g. flange or discharge nozzle) and place 
its tip against the 
seat of the balancing piston (Fig. 4-1), Carefully raise the shaft to its upper 
dead center, ensuring that here no additional sagging of the shaft, as this could give 
incorrect measurements.

The 
clearance measured should not exceed 1.0 mm If it does, the pump must be 
dismantled and overhauled The rotor clearances can only be measured with full accuracy when the 
pump is dismantled.
Figure (4): Measuring the rotor clearance

Check the balancing piston (603.02), balancing counter disk (602.02) and 
throttle bush (542.02) for damage.

When rework is carried out by means of a lathe mandrel, sufficient rubbing 
accuracy of the rubbing faces and bores is ensured (see Fig. 5-1). The 
admissible wobble is 0.02 mm.

Reduce the length of the balancing piston 
(603.02] at the pump-side front faces in such a way that the axial clearance of 
0.8 -1.2 mm between impeller and balancing disk is re-established. The rework 
necessitates re-adjustment of the rotor.

If wear due to running in the radial 
clearance between balancing counter disk (602.02) or throttle bush (542.02) 
and balancing piston (603.02) is to be removed by rework, the admissible 
clearances must be observed (Fig. 6-1). Individual deep scores may remain as 
they are.

sections.text: Assembly Steps
Assembling the pump insert.

Push the casing insert with the counter disc over the 
shaft and lock by means of the disc.
Adjust the rotor.
Fit the shaft seal.
Mount the radial bearing and raise the rotor.
Fit the thrust bearing and realize bearing clearance.

Now the pump insert is ready to be installed in the barrel 
 casing.
Make alignment.
